name: aster-support-fixture-v1
labeling_notes: Project-authored fictional support facts with explicit relevant chunks. This small illustrative fixture is not an external benchmark or a human annotation study.

chunks.text: Aster refunds are available within 30 days of purchase. Customers must provide the original receipt.
Aster shipping takes five business days for standard deliveries. Express shipping takes two business days.
Aster password reset links expire after 20 minutes. Request another link if the first one expires.
Aster support is available Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 UTC.
Aster invoices can be downloaded from the billing page. Only workspace administrators can change billing details.
Aster workspaces allow up to 12 members on the basic plan. The team plan allows up to 50 members.
Aster data exports remain available for seven days. Export files use the CSV format.
Aster account deletion includes a 14 day cancellation window. Deletion requests are submitted from account settings.
Aster API requests are limited to 100 requests per minute. Requests exceeding the limit receive status 429.
Aster API keys can be rotated from the developer page. Old API keys stop working immediately after rotation.
Aster backups are created every 24 hours. Backup retention lasts 21 days.
Aster attachments can be at most 25 megabytes each. Executable attachments are rejected.
Aster project names must contain between 3 and 60 characters. Project names may contain spaces.
Aster audit logs are retained for 90 days. Workspace administrators can export audit logs.
Aster maintenance is scheduled on Sundays at 02:00 UTC. Notices are posted 48 hours in advance.
Aster notifications can be paused for eight hours. Notification preferences are saved per user.
